title: attocube systems
summary: German maker of cryogenic nanopositioners and microscopy systems for quantum research.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

attocube builds nanopositioners, cryogenic scanning microscopes and optical cryostats used to characterise qubits and quantum materials at low temperature. Its piezo-based positioning works at millikelvin temperatures, a niche capability that few companies offer. The company supplies research labs and quantum-hardware developers.

Technology Exposure

  • Cryogenic nanopositioners
  • Low-temperature microscopes
  • Optical cryostats

What To Watch

  • Quantum research funding
  • Materials-research demand
  • Small-market competition

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
